successors.name: French Africa
successors.text: Gajaaga on both banks of the upper Senegal from the Kayes area downstream to Bakel (the river widened by 40 km, cut to that stretch; the page gives no outline)

ledger.x: 1858: the French annex half of Gooy and protect the rest.
1858: the end of the kingdom ("the kingdom existed from before 1000 CE to 1858").

wars.name: Kaarta and Khasso invasion of Gajaaga
wars.outcome: "In 1750, Kaarta and Khasso invaded, and although the invasion was defeated, it showed Gajaaga's weakness."

certainty.note: The page gives the river and the towns, no outline; the 1000 start is bridging.
